query:
select jsonb_build_object('captured_at',now(),'artifacts',jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('artifact_key',p.artifact_key,'published_at',p.published_at,'sha256',p.payload_sha256,'pitchers',(select jsonb_agg(
(select jsonb_object_agg(k,v) from jsonb_each(x) e(k,v) where k in ('pitcher','team','opp_team','game_time','k_line','book_odds','game_state','actual_ks','ref_book','batter_handedness_mode','lineup_real_split_count','lineup_path_a_fallback_count','lineup_split_source','lineup_used','lineup_count','line_source_provider','odds_source','market_source_mode','recent_start_count','avg_ip','last_pitch_count','days_since_last_start','season_k9','recent_k9','career_k9','is_opener','starter_mismatch','quality_gate_level','data_complete')) ||
jsonb_build_object('tracked_picks',(select jsonb_agg((select jsonb_object_agg(k,v) from jsonb_each(t) e(k,v) where k in ('pitcher','side','game_time','locked_at','locked_odds','locked_k_line','locked_verdict','ref_book','display_verdict','display_odds','display_k_line','result','actual_ks'))) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(x->'tracked_picks','[]'::jsonb)) t))
) from jsonb_array_elements(p.payload->'pitchers') x)) order by p.artifact_key)) as evidence
from public.published_pipeline_artifacts p where artifact_key between 'dated_slate:2026-07-24' and 'dated_slate:2026-09-03'
